author: StewieFG
body:
Hey! :D
Me, Zedther, and CharlZe made a map for Nexus, it's pretty much simple designed and gameplay wised  :) Hope you'll like!




Name: Laser Skirmish

Gamemode: Nexus

Creators: Zedther, ElectraXdroid, CharlZe

Info & Features:
-4 Teams
-2 Spawns for each team
-A lot of space for PvP
-Gameplay wised 
-2 PvP layers
-10v10v10v10

Images: http://imgur.com/a/7M4xF

Download: Coming soon.

YAML: http://www.mediafire.com/download/5vvlltyd761bnq0/yaml%282%29.txt

Hope you guys love it :) Feedback is always appreciated!
